headline_hook: Cursor Ships a Git Killer While NVIDIA's Robots Run Their Own Research Lab

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Origin isn't just another dev tool — it's the first admission that AI agents have outgrown the infrastructure humans built for themselves, and version control is merely the first domino in a full-stack rebuild of developer tooling around agent-native workflows.

model_literacy.relevance: With OpenAI's evals lead declaring current benchmarks broken and SkillsBench 1.1 launching as the first audited agent benchmark, today's news illustrates why the industry is scrambling to replace metrics that frontier models have already gamed or outgrown.

items.title: Cursor Unveils Origin — a Git Replacement Built for the Agent Era
items.angle: If every AI agent spawns branches in parallel, Git's merge model breaks. Origin is built from scratch for that world — extensible via API and MCP, with native conflict resolution for concurrent agent sessions.
items.key_fact: Built-in MCP integration and API-first extensibility for agent workflows

items.title: Zhipu Drops GLM-5.2 Open Weights — Claims Opus 4.8 Parity With 1M Context
items.angle: A novel IS attention mechanism that reuses one indexer every 4 sparse layers delivers 2.9x performance gains. China's open-weight frontier keeps closing the gap at a pace that makes export controls look like speed bumps.
items.key_fact: 2.9x performance gain via IS attention, 1M context window, open weights

items.title: OpenAI Codex Gains Browser, Computer Use, and Memory Across the EU
items.angle: Codex crosses from code-only into full desktop automation for European users — Chrome control, computer use, persistent memory, and chronicle all land at once.
items.key_fact: Chrome, Computer Use, Memory, and Chronicle now available in EU/EEA/UK

items.title: Alibaba's Qwen Releases a Full Foundation Model Suite for Robotics
items.angle: Alongside NVIDIA's ENPIRE, Qwen's Robot Suite marks a breakout week for physical AI — two major releases from different continents within days.
items.key_fact: Purpose-built model suite for physical world intelligence

items.title: UK Government Taps DeepMind to Fix Housing Planning With AI
items.angle: A direct government-DeepMind partnership tackling one of Britain's most intractable policy problems — AI leaves the lab for real bureaucratic operations.
items.key_fact: AI-powered prototype for housing planning decisions

items.title: NVIDIA's ENPIRE: 8 Codex Agents Autonomously Running a Robot Research Lab
items.angle: The first demonstration of fully autonomous AI research in the physical world — agents coordinate robots, GPUs, and token budgets with zero human intervention. AutoResearch graduates from simulation to real hardware.
items.key_fact: 8 Codex agents controlling a fleet of robots with no human in the loop

items.title: Anthropic Publishes Its Framework for Measuring Claude Code Economics at Scale
items.angle: Rare transparency into how agentic coding actually scales — Anthropic's first framework tracks usage patterns across users and task types, giving the industry real data instead of vibes.
items.key_fact: First published framework for measuring real-world agentic coding economics

items.title: OpenAI Simulates Deployment With Real User Requests Before Shipping Models
items.angle: A new pre-deployment safety method bridges the gap between lab evals and production by replaying de-identified user requests against unreleased models.
items.key_fact: De-identified user requests used to simulate real-world model behavior pre-release

items.title: SkillsBench 1.1: The First Fully Audited Benchmark for AI Agent Skill Use
items.angle: Benchmarks with errors poison model comparisons. SkillsBench 1.1 is end-to-end audited and verified error-free — setting a new bar for eval integrity.
items.key_fact: First benchmark for agent skill use that's been verified error-free

items.title: Willison: Fable 5 Export Controls Are Actively Weakening US Cyber Defense
items.angle: A counterintuitive but well-sourced argument — blocking Fable 5 from allied researchers denies them the best defensive AI tools available, making everyone less safe.
items.key_fact: Allied security researchers cut off from the most capable defensive AI

items.title: Mollick: You Have 4–8 Months to Harden Systems Before Mythos-Class Goes Open
items.angle: If open models trail closed source by 8–12 months and Mythos-class capabilities are now known, the math gives defenders a concrete countdown — not a vague warning.
items.key_fact: 4–8 month window before Mythos-class capabilities appear in open weights

items.title: Satya Nadella on Loopcraft: How Microsoft Thinks About the AI Platform Layer
items.angle: Nadella's essay on building AI ecosystems through stacked feedback loops gets the Latent Space deep-dive — a strategic lens for understanding Microsoft's platform bets.
items.key_fact: 'Loopcraft' framework — stacked feedback loops as platform strategy

items.title: OpenAI's Evals Lead: Current Benchmarks Are Failing and Here's What Comes Next
items.angle: As every lab races past existing benchmarks, OpenAI's frontier evals lead makes the case that the metrics themselves need replacing, not just topping.
items.key_fact: Benchmark saturation and gaming are undermining model comparisons

items.title: Reports: GPT 5.6 and Gemini 3.5 Approaching Fable Parity at Half the Cost
items.angle: If true, the Fable suspension matters less than it seems — equivalent capability from multiple providers may be weeks away at 2x lower cost.
items.key_fact: Fable-level performance reportedly at over 2x lower cost from OpenAI and Google

items.title: OpenAI Commits $160K to Astral and Codex Open-Source Maintainers
items.angle: Part of a $1M fund for developer tools — AI labs are now competing on ecosystem, not just model quality. Astral (ruff/uv) gets direct OpenAI backing.
items.key_fact: $160K to Astral and Codex maintainers, $1M total fund

items.title: Claude Code's Creator: 'My Entire CLAUDE.md Is Two Lines'
items.angle: Boris Cherny argues most engineers are over-engineering their configs — with better models you need less instruction, not more. A contrarian take from the person who built the thing.
items.key_fact: Creator of Claude Code uses a minimal 2-line configuration

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.179: Mid-Stream Connection Fix and Sandbox Performance
items.angle: Partial responses now survive connection drops, WSL2 scrolling works again, and sandbox no longer bloats tool descriptions on large repos.
items.key_fact: Mid-stream connection drops now preserve partial responses
